# ADR-ALIBABA-CLOUD-STUDIO-HARNESS-ADOPTION-001 — Alibaba Cloud Studio Harness (DeepSeek V4 Pro via Anthropic endpoint)

## Status

specified (accepted; slice-1 adoption decision under `PROJECT-GTKB-GOOSE-HARNESS-ADOPTION`, reframed to the Alibaba Cloud Studio harness). Authored from GO'd bridge proposal `gtkb-alibaba-cloud-studio-harness-slice1-adr` (Loyal Opposition GO at `-002`, Antigravity C, independent session).

## Context

The "Goose" harness was a clumsy desktop-GUI proxy for the Alibaba-hosted DeepSeek V4 Pro model. Owner decision `DELIB-20260708-REPLACE-GOOSE-WITH-ALIBABA-CLOUD-STUDIO-HARNESS` directs replacing it with a first-class, non-GUI "Alibaba Cloud Studio" harness. `SPEC-INTAKE-9ec893` establishes harness = (integration + model + configuration) with a preference for non-GUI, maximal-hook, direct-cloud integrations. The owner provisioned `.env.local` with `ALIBABA_API_KEY` and an `ALIBABA_ANTHROPIC_COMPATIBLE_ENDPOINT`. The rogue-Goose governance-bypass incident (`DELIB-20260708-GOOSE-GOV-BYPASS-INCIDENT`) demonstrated that a hookless GUI proxy can mutate governed state outside the PreToolUse gates — reinforcing the move to a full-hook integration. This harness instantiates the shared runtime defined by `ADR-CLOUD-HARNESS-TEMPLATE-001`.

## Decision

Establish the **Alibaba Cloud Studio** harness as a new registry identity `H` (`harness_name` "alibaba-cloud-studio"), hosting **DeepSeek V4 Pro** via the **Anthropic-compatible endpoint** (`ALIBABA_ANTHROPIC_COMPATIBLE_ENDPOINT`, env-keyed on `ALIBABA_API_KEY`, referenced by NAME only per `GOV-ENV-LOCAL-AUTHORITY-001`). This is a Claude-Code-style integration that inherits the **full native hook system** (a higher hook tier than a guard-adapter shim floor). **Retire Goose `G`** and obsolete all partial Goose artifacts (the goose shim script, `.goose/` adapters, and Goose capability/dispatch registry entries). The harness is an **instantiation of the `ADR-CLOUD-HARNESS-TEMPLATE-001` base runtime**, configured as: endpoint = the Anthropic-compatible endpoint; auth-env-key = `ALIBABA_API_KEY`; dialect = `anthropic-messages`; model = DeepSeek V4 Pro; hook tier = native full hooks.

## Rationale

- **Non-GUI + maximal hooks** is the `SPEC-INTAKE-9ec893` target; the Anthropic-compatible endpoint lifts the hook ceiling above the guard-adapter floor by letting Claude-Code-style native tooling drive the model.
- **Replace, don't extend:** continuing the hookless Goose GUI shim would hard-cap hook capability at the guard-adapter floor and preserve the ungoverned-mutation risk the Goose incident exposed.
- **Identity + model + config uniqueness:** DeepSeek V4 Pro via Alibaba Cloud Studio is a distinct harness from the same model via OpenRouter or Ollama (differing commercial rates/terms), so it warrants its own identity `H`.
- **Template reuse:** building on `ADR-CLOUD-HARNESS-TEMPLATE-001` means this harness inherits the base runtime's connection, retry, and Layer-3 guard-adapter enforcement rather than hand-rolling.

## Rejected Alternatives

- **Extend the Goose GUI/shim.** Rejected — hookless, clumsy proxy; hook-ceiling-capped; ungoverned-mutation risk (per the Goose bypass incident).
- **OpenAI-compatible shim only (no Anthropic endpoint).** Rejected — guard-adapter floor only; misses the full-hook ceiling the Anthropic endpoint provides.
- **Repurpose Goose identity `G` in place.** Rejected by owner AUQ (2026-07-08) in favor of a clean new identity `H` and retirement of `G`.
- **Interactive-only operating harness (non-dispatchable).** Rejected — owner directs a dispatchable, fully-capable LO/PB participant.

## Consequences

- **Slice plan:** slice 2 — register identity `H` + retire Goose `G` + `[harnesses.alibaba-cloud-studio]` capability-floor block + glossary entry + operating-model §3 entry + remove Goose artifacts (collision-free: Goose disabled/suspended per the incident response); slice 3 — the Anthropic-endpoint integration + native hook wiring built on the template base runtime (+ tool-parity `DCL` as generalized by the template); slice 4 — `_check_alibaba_cloud_studio_harness` doctor check + parity + tests.
- Supersedes the Goose-no-role standing decisions and the two withdrawn predecessor proposals (GUI-centric; DeepSeek-shim-centric).
- Depends on `ADR-CLOUD-HARNESS-TEMPLATE-001` for the shared runtime; its slice 3 lands after the template's base runtime (slice 2 of the template project).
- Risk (cloud Anthropic-endpoint fidelity): the achievable native-hook surface is bounded by the endpoint; the guard-adapter floor (inherited from the template) is the fallback. Resolved in slice 3.

## References

`DELIB-20260708-REPLACE-GOOSE-WITH-ALIBABA-CLOUD-STUDIO-HARNESS`; `SPEC-INTAKE-9ec893`; `ADR-CLOUD-HARNESS-TEMPLATE-001`; `GOV-HARNESS-ONBOARDING-CONTRACT-001`; `GOV-ENV-LOCAL-AUTHORITY-001`; `DELIB-20260708-GOOSE-GOV-BYPASS-INCIDENT`; bridge `gtkb-alibaba-cloud-studio-harness-slice1-adr` (GO at `-002`).
